sourceRecords.title: MODEC New Floating Wind Platform Design Gets ABS Approval in Principle
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that MODEC received Approval in Principle from ABS for its iTLP2-FOWT concept, a tension-leg platform floating offshore wind foundation. The source states that the design aims to minimise floater motions and seabed footprint and supports land-based turbine integration.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.
